note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (generic clause lines and liability categories, never real contract text). The two scenes are identical except one supplied fact: the status of the changed category ('Category included' vs 'Exclusion to be reviewed', ● and ◆ alike, same size, weight and timing). The cord only shows the supplied delimitation; no scene is preferred. No doctrine on limitation or exclusion clauses: no enforceability, validity or effect, no cap or amount, no outcome. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities, actorLabels (no actors), objectLabels (the props carry no names), finalState (the hold always shows both supplied statuses).
